nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: The website's only backend. One POST endpoint; the body's `action` field picks the route. Copy the Production URL into the website's settings.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: dashboard_key is the password the website sends with every request. Use a long random string — anyone with the webhook URL and this key can add topics and retry jobs.

nodes.name: Get Scene Progress
nodes.notes: Filtered to the same job ids as Get Jobs, so the two lists always line up.

nodes.name: Insert Topic
nodes.notes: Workflow 01 picks the new row up on its next scheduled run.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { code: 201, body: { ok: true, topic: $input.first().json } } }];

nodes.name: Apply Retry
nodes.notes: The status=eq filter makes this a compare-and-set: if a worker claimed the job between Plan Retry and now, zero rows update and Retry Result reports a conflict.

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: Every route ends here with { code, body }.
